description: Workflow for Creating a large disease network from various datasets and databases for IBM, and applying the active subnetwork identification method MOGAMUN.
name: Inclusion Body Myositis Active Subnetwork Identification Workflow
tools: converts the igraph network format to the mogamun input format
integrates all datasources into a single disease network
maps mirtarbase identifiers to identifiers consistent with datasets
maps string identifiers to identifiers consistent with datasets
processes output from mogamun, and merges overlapping subnetwork
runs the mogamun software with selected paramters
